primary_policy.target: Noninitial original chunk fragment whose complete original event and every preceding in-chunk event are intact; each eligible original event counted once.
exclusion_precedence: partial history among remaining complete queries
primary_policy.history: Short = all complete preceding events in that original chunk. Long = longest complete contiguous original-event suffix with deduplicated history KCs plus full query KCs <= 200.
primary_policy.partial_definition: Exact original KC start and stop boundaries, matching ktst_data._event_details; not merely equal KC sets.
primary_policy.ordering: Canonical source ordinal; repeated question IDs are separate events. AS15 question remains absent/dummy, not a true question identity.
primary_policy.labels: Binary/within-event consistency checked solely as input integrity; labels never determine target eligibility, history length, or sampling.

method: Hash only the two allowlisted development CSVs per dataset and their saved manifests; never call generic manifest verification that includes test.
Load captured hash-verified shared_events.py bytes with stdlib-only imports; use _events_from_row and _csv_rows only; do not instantiate SharedEventDataset or KTSTSequenceDataset.

One streaming alignment-and-coverage pass of original and chunk CSVs in pinned student order. Compare q/c/r/is_repeat of each chunk to its exact original slice; verify expected old audit aggregate counters without rerunning the old constructor audit.

After exact alignment and complete boundaries, compare canonical ordinal intervals using cumulative unique-KC costs. Export exact aggregate added-events/KC histograms, including zero, overall and first/subsequent chunks.
A separate secondary diagnostic drops only an initial incomplete history fragment and requires at least one remaining complete local event. Never merge recovered targets into the primary result.
Write an exclusive persistent attempt before opening or hashing any development CSV. Failure/timeout leaves failed attempt; no normal retry or output overwrite.
Recheck all captured input/control receipts and project source before publishing a single aggregate report.

secondary_drop_initial_partial_fragment.policy: Diagnostic only: drop the initial incomplete fragment, then require at least one complete local history event; do not add original first fragments or partial queries.

datasets.privacy: Aggregate counts only; no student IDs, event IDs, labels, or per-student statistics exported

limitations: This is structural coverage of existing training inputs, not a measured AUC improvement, training result, speedup, or proof that additional history helps.
First/subsequent chunk counts and exact affected target counts are reported separately; rows-minus-students is not used as a target impact estimate.
The strict primary excludes partial-query and partial-history cases. Secondary recovered counts do not silently change that policy.
A later one-target-per-chunk pilot would change supervision coverage and gradient variance; a negative low-coverage pilot would not rule out fully supervised history alignment.
180 seconds is a checked soft elapsed-time limit, not a hard process kill; failure requires explicit root investigation and no automatic rerun.
Only fold0 training membership (folds1-4) is in scope; no validation performance, inference, weights, test labels, or final-test release.
